Preserved existing lowercasing and punctuation behavior.
arguments.rationale: Using value.strip().lower().split() removes leading/trailing whitespace and splits on arbitrary whitespace, including tabs and newlines. Joining with hyphens yields an empty string for whitespace-only input and does not alter punctuation.
arguments.root_cause: The implementation used split(" "), which only recognized literal spaces and could preserve other whitespace or produce incorrect separators.
